about_the_game:
The Long Tale

by Syrnik Interactive 🕹️

You are a brave knight, arriving at the castle to save the princess.

But, as it often goes, she’s already gone.

The dragon, however, is still here.

The Long Tale is a hardcore pixel platformer with a black-and-white aesthetic inspired by the 8-bit era. Each level is a deadly trap, each step a decision, and death is not punishment — it’s progress.

[quote]⚔️ Features:

• Retro visuals with no wasted pixels — pure 8-bit soul

• Brutally fair levels — no scripts, no handholding

• The dragon awaits — but his secrets remain unknown

• Living level architecture — doors may mislead

• Instant restarts — trial and error, minus the pain

• Story told through gameplay — you piece it together yourself[/quote]

[quote]📜 Roadmap:

Chapter II — “Deeper Beneath the Castle”

Chapter III — “The City Above”

• Gamepad support

• New hardcore mode

• Level editor

• Original soundtrack and digital artbook

• Competitive challenge mode

• Secret levels and bonus content

• New enemies — including a particularly... smoky one

• Cosmetic unlocks

• Storyline expansion

• New achievements

• Release on mobile platforms[/quote]

short_description: The princess is gone, but the dragon stayed. Jump, die, rage, repeat — The Long Tale is a brutal black & white pixel platformer with deadly traps and no handholding. Each step is a decision. Warning: may cause obsession, retries beyond reason, and minor damage to keyboards.
